sourceFile: 73.BRS-2015 Report checking NTI  sample reduce coil 58 turn to 57 turn date 13.8.2024_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Comparable Normal vs Coil Test data exists, but the draft misstates the changed factor and uses weak outcome evidence grouping.
issues: Changed factor is the filename, not the actual coil-turn change.
Baseline and test conditions are marked unknown despite Normal and Coil Test columns.
Rows do not directly prove 58-turn vs 57-turn unless source title metadata is accepted.
Outcome grouping mixes headers and stats without citing data rows.
Fo Coil Test evidence is incomplete for all 10 samples.
requiredUserQuestions: May the file title be used as evidence that Coil Test is the 57-turn reduced coil?
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to coil turns reduced from 58 to 57 if title metadata is allowed.
Set baseline as Normal/58-turn and changed condition as Coil Test/57-turn, or limit to Normal vs Coil Test.
Group SPL, THD, IMP, and Fo as outcomes under one validation context.
Cite header rows plus representative data or average rows for each outcome.
Include all relevant Fo Normal and Coil Test rows or averages.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations prove Normal vs Coil Test headers, but not the 58-to-57 turn meaning without title metadata.
